table.retrieve:
SELECT
	H.GlVochCode,
	H.VoucherCode,
	VoucherType=V.Name,
	H.Date,
	U.UserCode,
	Username=U.UserName,
	H.Posted,
	H.PostDate,
	D.AccCode,
	D.Remarks,
	Cheque=D.Chkno,
	D.Debit,
	D.Credit,
	AccountName=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	InvoiceCode=D.InvoiceCode,
	InvoiceBased=V.InvoiceBased
FROM
	GlDetail D, 
	GlHeader H,
	VocherCategory V,
	Users U,
	Accounts A
WHERE
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND
	H.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
	H.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode AND
	H.VochCatCode = V.VochCatCode AND
	H.SalesManCode = U.UserCODE AND
	D.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	H.VochCatCode >= 
		CASE :ai_VochCatCode 
		WHEN 5 THEN 5 
		ELSE 6 END AND 
	H.VochCatCode <= 
		CASE :ai_VochCatCode 
		WHEN 5 THEN 5 
		ELSE (SELECT MAX(VochCatCode) FROM VocherCategory WHERE POSTED='Y') END
ORDER BY
	V.Name,
	H.GlVochCode,
	D.Identitycol,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName
